title: Each OpenCode account is held only on its own key's limit
description: Three OpenCode accounts with three keys, whose live checks a shared OpenCode service answered with another login's refusal: only the over-limit account reads spent, until its own reset; the probe records a fingerprint of the key it used; a master's available mark holds until that account's own key reads otherwise; and the Agents page shows the spent account's reset in one line and the mismatched live answer as a fault on each usable account.
